title: Dreamscape Induction (Naked Audio)
description: There's no need for the roles we play tonight baby, I just want to hold you tight and take care of everything for us just this once. You know I can do that for you. Make you feel good — I really really really want to make you feel good. And not just good. I want to make you feel amazing. And it all starts with simply controlling the breath for me, counting them in and out at the pace that feels right for you. Closing your eyes. Because you don't need to keep them open, not when you're with me, when you can sense me here so close to us. Not when you let go this way, to feel me and play with me between the sheets. As you touch. And I lick — As we shift and squirm into each other, swept down into the welcoming covers of our feather bed. And all the places where this bond can take us. Falling into a warm soft cushion portal, away to the dreamscape weaved between my voice and your subconscious.
author: Mistress Shibby
